name: Quick Convert
author: Misty
overview: Quick Convert creates collision-safe media copies without leaving Misty. It runs only the verified FFmpeg shipped with the installed extension.
capabilities: Convert the currently selected file into common image, audio, and video formats
Write converted copies beside the source file with predictable names
Use the pinned, extension-bundled FFmpeg and FFprobe executables
permissions: Write access beside the selected file
Execute the verified bundled FFmpeg and FFprobe tools
getting_started: Install Quick Convert from Misty's marketplace.
Select an image, audio, or video file in Files.
Use the Quick Convert panel to choose an output format.
changelog: v0.3.0 - Added popup-first launch behavior, bridge readiness, and automatic job recovery.
v0.2.0 - Added secure hosted conversion jobs with quality and destination controls, cancellation, collision-safe output names, and output reveal.
v0.1.0 - Added a selected-file conversion panel backed by system FFmpeg.
